earned_statement: The pink diamond is the four-leaf quotient of the eight-arc rosette obtained by forgetting the binary arc side. It is neither the full eight-chart fiber nor one absolute four-chart section. No native outer-C2-invariant binary observable separates the two four-chart sections. Registration-dominant and signature-dominant roles are available only as a covariant exchanged pair, and an external C2 registration bit is required to name them.
